description.en:
I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of “a certain modern fantasy” I loved so much.

And on that very day, I got transported into that fantasy world.
As none other than a newly hired employee at a renowned major corporation!

A dream workplace with tons of benefits, a high salary, and kind, competent supervisors.

Using my knowledge of the world, I quickly climb the corporate ladder!

But am I happy, you ask?

Please, let me go back home.
description.es:
Asistí al evento especial de un pop-up sobre "cierta novela de fantasía" que me gustaba, tanto que hasta pedí algunos de mis preciados días libres para poder ir. 

Y ese mismo día, fui directamente arrastrado al interior de dicha novela, ¡nada más y nada menos que como empleado recién contratado por una gran y famosa compañía! 

Disponía de buenos beneficios, buen salario, superiores amables y competentes... sin duda un trabajo de ensueño. 

Y haciendo provecho de toda la información que sólo yo sabía respecto a este mundo, ¡conseguí ganarme sucesivamente el acenso en un tiempo récord! 

¿Que si estoy feliz? 

Por favor, simplemente regrésenme a casa, se los suplico.

description.en: A rumor goes around school about an abandoned amusement park and a magician who lives there that can make someone disappear for good. Yoon Ah-ee, a girl struggling to feed her sister and herself everyday will experience her life change as she meets a mysterious magician.
description.uk: Школою ширяться чутки про занедбаний парк розваг і фокусника, який там живе і може змусити когось зникнути назавжди. Юн А-і, дівчинка, яка щодня намагається прогодувати свою сестру і себе, відчує, як змінюється її життя, коли вона зустрічає таємничого чарівника.
description.pt-br: Há um boato de que um mágico vive na barraca perto do parque temático abandonado; alguns até dizem que a mágica dele é real. No entanto, antes de iniciar seu show, ele sempre pergunta ao público: "Você acredita em mágica?" Para Yoon Ah-ee, a magia parece uma memória distante. Diante da dura realidade da pobreza, ela passa seu tempo estudando, trabalhando e cuidando de sua irmã mais nova na ausência de seus pais. Ela não acredita mais nas maravilhas da magia, assim como seu colega de classe cética Na Il-Deung, que foi criado para acreditar que uma boa educação é a única maneira de encarar a vida. Quando Ah-ee tropeça no parque temático abandonado e tem um encontro casual com o mágico, sua vida muda para sempre. Annarasumanara revela uma história filosófica, comovente e instigante do que significa crescer na pessoa que você deseja ser.

description.en:
I wanted to design!

A dream I have had since I was 12 years old and have nurtured since then. For thirty years I worked hard, not missing a single day, but the reality is that I'm a construction site manager constructing buildings for other people. If I hadn't made that choice back then... Would I have become an architectural designer? Thirty years after all that, a miracle happened to me.

I went back to my university school days 20 years ago, in 2010.
I'm 22 years old, but with 20 years of field experience, I'm going fulfil my dream of being an architectural designer and make world famous designs of my own!

description.en:
The protagonist finds herself possessing the body of April, a side character destined to be used by the villain and eventually killed by the male lead. Ignoring the original plot, she resolves to live a quiet life running a café in the countryside.

However, her plans begin to unravel when she discovers that the boy she’s been caring for is actually the nephew the male lead has been desperately searching for.

April ends up becoming the male lead’s personal barista, brewing magical coffee for him every night, and eventually running a café in the capital. She tells herself it’s only until the female lead appears, but as she slowly opens up to the male lead, she finds herself becoming more and more entangled in a life by his side.
description.fr: Tout au long de l'histoire, le personnage d'April est utilisée comme une marionnette, servant de pion pour les intérêts des uns et des autres. Elle finit par mourir, tuée par le héros. Quand notre protagoniste comprend le sort qui l'attend, elle décide d'ignorer l'histoire originale et de vivre en gérant un café dans une campagne tranquille, mais quand il s'avère que le garçon dont elle a commencé à s'occuper par hasard est en fait le neveu que recherche le protagoniste masculin, sa détermination commence à s'égarer...
description.ko:
악당에게 이용당하다 남주에게 죽임을 당하게 되는 조연, 에이프릴에게 빙의한 주인공. 

원작은 무시하고 한적한 시골에서 카페나 운영하며 살겠노라 다짐하지만, 
우연히 돌봐주기 시작한 남자아이가 사실은 남주가 찾아헤메던 조카였다는 사실이 밝혀지며 그녀의 다짐은 크게 틀어지기 시작한다. 

남주의 전속 바리스타가 되어 매일 밤 마법을 담은 커피를 내려주고, 
수도의 카페를 운영하게 된 에이프릴. 
여주가 나타날 때까지만, 하고 점점 남주에게 곁을 내어주기 시작한 그녀는 점점 그의 곁에서 머무는 삶에 빠져들게 된다.
description.ru:
— Я буду жить здесь с сестрой!

У нее была второстепенная роль, которую подстегнул злодей и убил главный герой, герцог Клайв Винтервиль. Кроме того, она случайно подобрала его племянника!

Более того…

— Лучше скажи мне правду. Как ты меня усыпила?

Как и в оригинальном романе, была раскрыта ее способность лечить бессонницу Клайва. В конце концов, она даже получила предложение в качестве его эксклюзивного бариста готовить ему «кофе для сна»!

Однако, чтобы избежать флага смерти, ей пришлось отклонить предложение…

— Я открою кафе в столице, и, конечно, владельцем будешь ты, Эйприл.

Как и ожидалось, лучшее лечение — это финансовое лечение.

— Я сделаю это!

Она приняла предложение, ослепленная мечтой открыть собственное кафе. Она просто пыталась помочь ему хорошо заснуть и взяла Клайва за руку только из-за выгодного предложения… но почему он вдруг стал одержим?

— Я не позволю тебе пожалеть о своем решении.

Почему-то его взгляд выглядел необычно.

description.de:
Seit sie im Alter von acht Jahren zur Heiligen ernannt wurde, hat Gloria Dämonen bezwungen und verletzte Soldaten geheilt. Doch eines Tages wendet sich das Imperium gegen sie: Unter falschen Anschuldigungen wird sie zur Verräterin erklärt und durch eine gehorsamere Heilige ersetzt.

Von Zorn und Verrat getrieben, schart Gloria eine Gruppe treuer Gefolgsleute um sich, um die Wahrheit ans Licht zu bringen und Vergeltung zu üben. Doch wird sie es schaffen, ihre Feinde zu bezwingen und ihren Namen wieder reinzuwaschen – oder wird der Pfad der Rache sie ins Verderben führen?
description.en:
Since being marked as a saint at the tender age of 8, Gloria has been slaying demons and healing soldiers on the battlefield. That is, until one day, the Empire decides to cast her aside in favor of a new, more docile saint by framing her as a fake. Quick to switch to solution mode, Gloria assembles a motley crew and sets up a plan to take revenge on those who wronged her. With her hunky acolytes and her trusted mace in hand, can she restore her honor and make the damned rascals pay?
___
[I don't care if she's a fake saint, I have a trusted ally and the power to take revenge.]

For many years I lived as a healer for the heroes of the Empire. I've participated in countless demon slayings and shed blood countless times. Until one day, a woman claimed to be a real saint.

"How could you have fooled me for so long?"

"I can't believe it. Don't you know shame?"

Then, as if waiting, everyone turned away from me. Pointing fingers at me, calling me a fake. Yeah, it's dirty, it's mean, and I'm done. I threw the mace on the floor, and the hard marble floor shattered in an instant.
description.fr: Alors que Gloria n'est qu'une orpheline, vagabondant dans les rues et mendiant son repas, un stigmate sous forme de lumière lui grave un hexagramme sur le front. Elle devient alors l'enfant de l'oracle, autrement dit, la sainte. À cause de son pouvoir de guérison, elle est envoyée en expédition punitive afin de débarrasser l'empire de ses monstres. Hélas, Gloria refuse qu'on se serve d'elle comme d'un pantin et dès lors, un complot est monté contre elle pour la destituer de son rôle de sainte. Elle refuse de laisser ses tyrans s'en tirer à bon compte et prévoit de leur faire payer. Au cours de sa vengeance, elle rencontre différentes personnes, qui lui feront découvrir ce qu'est le bonheur, l'amitié et l'amour.
description.ko:
[가짜 성녀라고 해도 상관 없어. 믿을 수 있는 동료와 복수할 수 있는 힘을 얻었으니까.]

긴 세월 제국 영웅들의 치료제로 살았다.
수많은 마물 토벌에 참전해, 수없이 피를 내줘야만 했다.

그러던 어느 날,
자신이 진짜 성녀라고 주장하는 여자가 나타났다.

“어떻게 그 긴 시간 동안 감쪽같이 속일 수가 있지?”
“믿을 수가 없군. 그대는 수치심이라는 걸 모르는가.”

그러자, 모두가 기다렸다는 듯 내게서 등을 돌렸다.
나를 ‘가짜’라고 손가락질하면서.

“안 한다니까요.”
“……뭐라고?”
“성녀 안 한다고요.”
“…….”

그래, 더럽고 치사해서
다 때려치우고 만다.

들고 있던 메이스를 바닥에 내던지자,
단단한 대리석 바닥이 순식간에 박살이 났다.

“그러니까, 잘나신 분들끼리 잘 해보시라고요.”
description.pl: Odkąd, gdy w wieku 8 lat została naznaczona jako święta, Gloria zabijała demony i leczyła żołnierzy na polu bitwy. Aż pewnego dnia Imperium postanawia porzucić ją na rzecz nowej, bardziej potulnej świętej, nazywając Glorię jako oszustkę. Gloria szybko postanowiła rozwiązać swój problem i zaczęła zbierać barwną ekipę i opracowywać plan zemsty na tych, którzy ją skrzywdzili. Czy z jej przystojnymi pomocnikami i zaufaną bronią w ręce zdoła odzyskać honor i sprawić, by te przeklęte dranie za wszystko zapłacili?
description.ru:
На протяжении многих лет я служила целителем для героев Империи. Я участвовала в бесчисленных охотах на демонов и много раз проливала кровь. Но однажды женщина заявила, что она настоящая святая.

"Как ты могла обманывать меня так долго?"

"Я не могу в это поверить. Разве ты не знаешь, что такое стыд?"

Затем, как будто ждали этого момента, все отвернулись от меня. Они указывали на меня пальцем, называя меня подделкой. Да, это грязно, это жестоко, и мне этого достаточно. Я бросила булаву на пол, и твердый мраморный пол рассыпался в мгновение ока.

"Пусть добряки занимаются своим делом."
description.zh: “即使被他们说是假圣女也没关系。我已经得到了可以信任的伙伴和报仇的力量。” 在漫长的岁月里，我一直是帝国那些英雄们的治疗剂。我参加了无数次魔物讨伐，无休止地流血。 直到有一天，出现了一位自称为真正圣女的女人。 “你怎么能欺骗我那么长时间？” “我简直不敢相信，你这么不知廉耻吗？” 然后，大家就迫不及待似的离开了我，用手指着我说： “假的” “当不了了哦” “……什么？” “当不了圣女了” “……” 于是，愤怒而鲁莽的我把握在手里的狼牙棒扔在地上，坚硬的大理石地板马上碎裂开来。 “这就是为什么我告诉你，请与优秀的人一起工作。”

Doch hinter der perfekten Fassade verbirgt sich ein mehr als nur schwieriger Charakter. Während er immer wieder andere Frauen verschreckt, ist seine Sekretärin Kim Miso nach neun Jahren Zusammenarbeit immer noch die einzige Person, die mit einem Lächeln im Gesicht mit ihm umgehen kann. Kann sich aus ihrer rein professionellen Beziehung am Ende vielleicht mehr entwickeln?
description.en: Vice Chairman Lee Youngjun has everything: the looks, the brains, the money... so when his secretary of nine years, Kim Miso, tells him she wants to quit to “live her own life,” he’s taken aback. Realizing Miso is quitting with the intention of getting married, Youngjun offers what he thinks is the best option—himself. Unfortunately for him, a narcissist like Youngjun just isn’t Miso’s type. But how far is Youngjun willing to go to keep his favorite secretary by his side?
description.fr: Lee Yeong Jun est l'héritier d'une entreprise prestigieuse, qu'il mène à la baguette. Beau, intelligent mais surtout imbu de lui-même, il considère qu'il est l'image de la perfection. Alors, quand sa secrétaire personnelle, Kim Mi So, lui annonce qu'elle veut démissionner, c'est la douche froide! Qu'est-ce qui lui est bien passé par la tête, après neuf ans de bons et loyaux services? Pour la garder auprès de lui, Lee Yeong Jun est prêt à tout... même les plus grandes excentricités!
description.it: L'arrogante, bello e straricco Youngjoon è il Vice Presidente di un'importante società. Miso è stata la sua perfetta segretaria, considerata una leggenda per essere sopravvissuta al suo capo narcisista per 9 lunghi anni. Ma ora che ha deciso di mollare, non c'è davvero niente - o nessuno - che possa impedirle di andarsene? Basato sui romanzi originali di Jeong Gyeong Yun ed ora adattato ad un drama televisivo coreano (in onda nel Giugno 2018).

description.ru:
Ли Ён Джун - самовлюблённый и высокомерный мужчина. Он - нарцисс и всё его внимание приковано только к своей персоне. Он очень любит себя и часами проводит время перед зеркалом, любуюсь и восхищаясь собой. Ён Джун является вице-президентом компании "Юиль Груп", у него высокий интеллект, но очень завышенная самооценка.
Вот уже девять лет в его компании работает девушка по имени Ким Ми Со. Она - его секретарь и все эти годы она ни с кем не встречалась. Всю себя она отдала работе, но в один прекрасный день ей надоело терпеть характер директора и она подала заявление об уходе. "Что не так, секретарь Ким?" - задал ей вопрос Ли Ён Джун. Что же случилось и почему она покидает компанию, которой отдала лучшие годы жизни? Это и предстоит узнать главному герою, ведь было задето его самолюбие. А может быть, он просто влюблён в неё?

description.en: Woohyun is rich, good-looking and popular… but he also happens to be a total bully. His punching bag is Ha Yan, a stuttering and amenable girl in his class. Woohyun likes nothing more than harassing her… The weird thing is, Ha Yan actually seems to crave his attention, feeding off it. As they each spin a web of deceit to ensnare the other, who will end up getting caught? And could romance bloom from this tangled, thorny mass of obsession?
What if there was a save point in my life? A man that turns back the time several hundred times per day.

In the near future, the education system has evolved into a military competition between youths over the domination of others. The stakes are high here: the winner takes all from the loser. description.en:
A long, long time ago, two siblings climbed up a rope to the heavens after being chased by a tiger. During that time, the younger sister Dalhee became a Moon Fairy. To become a true god, she must reincarnate a certain number of times, but she's never been able to successfully live out her lives. Bored of her life in heaven, she looked down Iseugkyung to look for any troubles in the human world!  
  
"Please help me… I want to die…"  
  
 After hearing a sad voice coming from Iseugkyung, she discovered a beautiful girl begging the Grim Reaper to leave her world. Soon after, the Grim Reaper came to take her life. Full of curiosity, Fairy Dalhee went down Iseugkyung and into the hospital room of the human girl.  
  
The woman who begged to die was surrounded by many people, and told Dalhee about her finace, Jiwan, who wasn't even a bit affectionate towards her.   
  
He didn't have a hint of compassion, despite learning that his fiancee was on the brink of death. It was surprising that this kind of person was alive on earth, rather than staying stuck in hell.   
  
Who is Dalhee? Is she not a kind and beautiful fairy?

description.en:
I possessed a supporting character in a reverse harem novel. A young concubine who, in the end, was driven to death for treason after begging for attention from the regnant empress who was the female lead, and doing wicked things to the male leads who were the concubines. Despite everything, the fortunate thing was that I possessed her right after entering the Imperial Palace. Even if everyone in the Imperial Palace were wary of me, they didn’t hate me yet.

‘Let’s not be impudent, and be obedient.’

I obstinately didn’t need nor have the mindset of trying to be loved by the Empress. Although the male leads who were the concubines were giving me glances, I could just lie flat. Since it wasn’t even a very difficult thing, I really did so. It was definitely like that, but–

“Come to my bedchamber tonight. I’ll read you a fairy tale book!”

“P-please don’t cry. I’ll give you this.”

Just why is everyone’s attitude endlessly gentle? I couldn’t understand. And it was baffling.

‘…I don’t need it though?’

I wasn’t really a young kid lacking affection. And that gaze in which they looked at me as if I were the loveliest in the world was extremely uncomfortable. Just where would I use a fairy tale book that’s full of jewels and silk, and the magic pearl which is the Imperial family’s heirloom? Since it’s already been done, I just wish for everyone to get out of my palace.

*Beware, for the shadow speaks.*

When junior knight Roselyn is rescued from the bottom of a cliff after an ambush by an enemy kingdom, her brother Calix is relieved – that is, until he learns that she's lost her memory. Now, she behaves like a child, eats like a horse, and wields unbelievable strength. But something's not quite right...

---
When you enter the deep forest, you will be devoured by the shadow. The shadow in the forest moves when no one is looking. In the deep forest, there is a shadow that mimics humans. The shadow speaks.

Rosalin of the White Night Chivalric Order went missing after suffering from an unexpected enemy attack during a hunting competition. They were able to find her unconscious and heavily wounded under a cliff, but when she woke up a few days later, she was rendered incapable of even simple speech due to acute amensia.

She roamed around the house, barefoot in her pyjamas, and spoke without honorifics. She would even eat food off the floor!

She’s bizarre, no matter how you look at it. Is this truly Rosalin?

description.en:
Roelle Chloe has never been able to feel emotions. Even during her past life, living as an outcast in the back alleys of the capital, the empire's most hated mage didn't shed a single tear. And dying at the hands of her father didn't improve her inability to feel empathy. But after being given a second chance at life after death, Roelle realizes that she might be able to use her magical gifts to change her bitter fate. From friendship to romance, and even family... Can Roelle use her blood magic for good while learning to love and be loved?
___
Roe, the main character, has difficulty understanding the feelings of others. One day, she witnesses a murder scene and is branded as the culprit. Framed and called the “Diabolical Witch—Murderer,” she dies by her father’s hands. However… She who definitely died under her her father’s resentful gaze before she somehow returns to her 15-year-old self, five years before her death. As a blunt person who cannot sympathize with or understand other people’s feelings, Roe only thought it to be annoying to have to repeat the same life again, and… Contrary to her expectations that it would simply be a repetition of the past, her life gets entangled with life’s events and she starts heading in a new direction…! 

A Romance Fantasy full of her development, as transparent watercolors slowly spread into her once grey and monotonous life!
description.es: Roe, la protagonista, tiene dificultades para comprender los sentimientos de los demás. Un día, presencia la escena de un asesinato y es señalada como la culpable. Inculpada y calificada de “bruja diabólica asesina”, muere a manos de su padre. Sin embargo… La que definitivamente murió ante la mirada resentida de su padre, de alguna manera se reencarna en su yo de 15 años, cinco años antes de su muerte. Como persona brusca que no puede simpatizar ni comprender los sentimientos de los demás, Roe sólo pensó que sería molesto tener que repetir de nuevo la misma vida, y… Contrariamente a sus expectativas de que sería simplemente una repetición del pasado, ¡su vida se enreda con los acontecimientos de la vida y empieza a tomar una nueva dirección…! ¡Una Fantasía Romántica llena de su desarrollo, mientras acuarelas transparentes se extienden lentamente en su vida una vez gris y monótona!
description.id: Karakter utama, Roe, yang telah menjalani kehidupan yang membosankan dan tidak mampu memahami emosi orang lain, suatu hari tiba-tiba menyaksikan adegan pembunuhan, dicap sebagai penjahat, dan dijebak sebagai 'penyihir - pembunuh terburuk' dan meninggal di tangan ayahnya, kami akan menemuimu. Tapi...dia meninggal di bawah tatapan kebencian ayahnya, dan entah bagaimana dia kembali ke masa kecilnya, pada usia lima belas tahun, lima tahun sebelum kematiannya. Sebagai orang blak-blakan yang tidak bisa bersimpati atau memahami emosi orang lain, rasanya menjengkelkan harus mengulangi kehidupan yang sama lagi... Bertentangan dengan ekspektasinya bahwa itu hanya pengulangan dari masa lalu yang sama, hidupnya adalah sebuah peristiwa. dan mulai bergerak ke arah yang baru...! Fantasi romansa penyembuhan yang berkembang di mana cat air transparan mulai meresap ke dalam kehidupannya yang kering dan kelabu sedikit demi sedikit!
description.ko: 타인의 감정을 이해할 수 없는 무미건조함 속에 살아온 주인공, 로에는 어느 날 갑자기 살인 현장을 목격함과 동시에 범인으로 낙인 찍혀 '최악의 마법사 - 살인사' 라는 누명을 쓴 채 자신의 아버지에 손에 죽음을 맞이하게 된다. 그런데.....분명 원망 어린 아버지의 눈빛 속에 죽었던 그녀는 어찌된 영문인지 죽음을 맞이하기 5년 전인 열 다섯 살, 그녀의 어린 시절로 회귀하게 된다. 타인의 감정에 공감할 수도, 이해할 수도 없는 무뚝뚝한 로에로서는 다시 똑같은 삶을 반복해야 한다는 것이 귀찮기만 하고.......그저 똑같은 과거의 반복일 것이라 생각한 그녀의 예상과는 달리,그녀의 삶은 사건과 얽히며 새로운 방향으로 나아가기 시작하는데....! 건조한 회색빛이었던

description.de: Chloe Garnache ist ein verführerischer Köder für den Kaiser. Nachdem sie ein Leben voller Missbrauch durch ihre Familie erleiden musste, wurde Chloe schließlich von Großherzog Kairos Ludwig aus ihrer Tortur befreit. Allerdings sind die Tage, in denen sie ausgenutzt wurde, noch lange nicht vorüber. Der einzige Grund, warum Kairos Chloe aufgenommen hat, ist ihre Schönheit, die er benutzen will, um den Kaiser zu verführen und zu töten. Chloe, die seinen freundlichen und sanften Gesten verfallen ist, folgt seinen Anweisungen bereitwillig. Bedauerlicherweise werden ihre Gefühle nie erwidert und sie stirbt einen kläglichen Tod, nachdem sie ihre Aufgabe erfüllt hat. Doch gerade als das Ende nah zu sein scheint, findet sich Chloe zu dem Zeitpunkt wieder, bevor ihr Leben bergab ging. Und dieses Mal wird sie sich nicht von den süßen Worten des teuflischen Großherzogs verführen lassen...
description.en:
Chloe Garnache is an alluring trap for the emperor. 

After living a life full of abuse at the hands of her family, Chloe is finally freed from her torture by the grand duke, Kairos Ludwig. 

However, her days of getting taken advantage of are far from over. The only reason Kairos took her in is because of her beauty, which he plans to use in order to lure and kill the emperor. Chloe willingly follows Kairos’ orders, having fallen for his kind and gentle gestures. Unfortunately, her feelings are never returned, and she is met with a pitiful death once her task is fulfilled. 

But just when things seem to be over, Chloe awakens to find herself back before her life came spiraling down. And this time, she won’t be swayed by the sweet words of the devilish grand duke…
description.fr: Chloé Garnache est un séduisant appât pour l’empereur. Après avoir subi de multiples abus de la part de sa famille, Chloé est enfin libérée de toute cette torture par le grand duc Kairos Ludwig. Cependant, les gens sont loin d’avoir fini de profiter d’elle. La seule raison pour laquelle Kairos l’a prise sous son aile, c’est à cause de sa beauté… une beauté qu’il compte bien utiliser afin de séduire, puis tuer l’empereur. Tombée sous le charme des douces paroles de Kairos, Chloé suit ses ordres de son plein gré, espérant que ses sentiments pour lui pourront être ne serait-ce qu’un tout petit peu réciproques. Malheureusement, ce ne sera jamais le cas et elle finira par mourir de façon pathétique une fois que sa tâche auprès de l’empereur sera accomplie. Mais, alors que tout semble être fini pour elle, Chloé se réveille soudain dans le passé, juste avant que sa vie ne commence à dégringoler. C’est l’occasion pour elle de reprendre les choses en main, et cette fois-ci, elle ne se laissera pas convaincre par les doux airs de ce démon de grand duc…
description.id: Tumbuh besar tanpa kasih sayang membuat Chloe Gonesh terbuai oleh kebaikan dari laki-laki yang mengulurkan tangan dan menyelamatkannya dari kejamnya dunia. Lama-kelamaan perasaannya itu terus bertumbuh menjadi cinta. Tapi, Chloe baru sadar bahwa selama ini, laki-laki yang dicintainya itu hanya memanfaatkannya sebagai umpan yang akan dilemparkan untuk sang kaisar.
description.ko:
사랑하는 남자를 위해 모든 것을 다 바쳤으나 끝내 비참하게 죽고 만 클로이 가넷슈.
어리석은 클로이는 너무 늦게 깨달았다.
그녀는 남자가 황제에게 던져 줄 미끼였고, 남자는 다정함을 가장한 아름다운 개새끼였다.

*

“숙부님이 좋아요.”

열일곱의 나는 그만큼 어리고 미숙해서, 갈수록 커져 가는 마음을 감추지 못했다.

“사랑하고 있어요, 오래전부터.”

느른하게 턱을 괴고서 내 몸을 훑어보는 눈길에 몸이 쭈뼛거렸지만 나는 용기를 내 그에게 한 발짝 다가갔다.

“사랑이라. 너도 벌써 그런 나이가 되었구나.”

그의 손끝이 내 얼굴을 쓸어내렸다.
예기치 못한 고백에도 그는 지나치게 여유롭고 능숙했다.

“나도 네가 좋아, 클로이. 사랑하고 있지.
장차 내게 아우님의 목을 가져다줄 너를, 내가 어떻게 어여뻐하지 않을 수 있을까.""

내가 사랑하고 있는 남자는 너무나 다정해서 더욱 잔인한 남자였다.

“황제의 아이를 낳아.”

* * *

다시 눈을 떴을 때 창백해진 얼굴로 날 내려다보는 그가 있었다.
나의 사랑을 짓밟고 나를 망가뜨린 남자였다.
description.ru:
Хлоя Ганешью пожертвовала всем ради возлюбленного, в том числе и собственной жизнью.
Осознание пришло к наивной девушке слишком поздно.

Притворившись нежным и чутким, этот ласковый ублюдок воспользовался ею как наживкой для императора.
— Вы мне нравитесь, господин.

Мне было семнадцать. Я была глупой и незрелой, не способной сдерживать собственные чувства.
— Я люблю вас уже давно.

Под его взглядом всё моё тело словно застыло, но я нашла в себе смелость и шагнула к нему навстречу.
— Любишь, значит. Да, ты действительно повзрослела.

Он ласково коснулся моего лица.
Слишком спокойный, несмотря на внезапное признание.
— Ты мне тоже нравишься, Хлоя. Я люблю тебя. Как же не любить ту, кто принесёт мне голову моего брата?

description.de: Minjoo wird als Schurkin Dahlia Margaret in einem Fantasyroman wiedergeboren und ist niedergeschmettert von der Tatsache, dass ihr ein früher Tod bevorsteht. Aber wenigstens ist sie Sooyeon, der Tyrannin ihrer Highschool entkommen. Oder? Als Dahlia auf Flore trifft, ihre jüngere Schwester und Gegenspielerin im Buch, wird ihr klar, dass es sich dabei um niemand Geringeren handelt als ihre ehemalige Peinigerin. Getrieben von dem Wunsch zu überleben und am besten gleich Rache zu nehmen, ist Dahlia nun auf der Suche nach mächtigen Verbündeten. Ein gut aussehender Adeliger scheint ein geeigneter Kandidat zu sein. Aber wird ein Deal mit dem mysteriösen Mann Dahlia wirklich helfen, ihre Ziele zu erreichen? Oder erwarten sie unangenehme Überraschungen?
description.en:
Reborn into a fantasy novel as a wicked character fated to meet an early demise, Minjoo - now Dahlia Margaret - has a lot on her plate right from the start. But at least she’s now free of her vicious high school bully, Sooyeon. Or is she? When Dahlia meets Flore, her estranged sister and the protagonist of the novel, she is shocked to find that the girl bears a suspicious resemblance to the classmate who tormented her. Now, driven by the desire to save her own life and also get revenge, Dahlia needs to make a powerful ally, and she has her eye on a handsome royal who just might be perfect for the job. However, a deal with this mysterious man might mean more than she bargained for…

---
I wasn't able to overcome the harassment and took my life, but I was reincarnated with the perpetrator? The perpetrator is the heroine, Florre, and I am the villainess, Dahlia, who's going to die horribly.

"They said you are a villain with neither blood nor tears, but unlike the rumors, you often shed tears."

"Your Highness must believe all the nonsense the idiots are talking about, huh?"

Grand Duke of Cervian, the half brother of the male lead and who will be punished for treason afterwards. He approached me. I can't lose the man who will be my greatest ally.

"Your Highness, would you marry me?"

"Now… what did you say?"

"And take revenge together."

A similar situation, a fixed ending. The heroine is not the only one who knows the ending of the novel. I took a long and arduous path of revenge.
description.es: Minjoo sufría el bullying constante de Sooyeon, pero todo cambia cuando las estudiantes que se odiaban a muerte terminan reencarnando en una novela: Sooyeon aparece en el cuerpo de Flore, la heroína, y Minjoo reencarna en el personaje de Dalia, la villana. Minjoo quiere vengarse de su acosadora, pero para eso debe elaborar un plan y aliarse con el archiduque Yohan. La venganza es un plato que se sirve frío…
description.fr: Minjoo ne s'attendait pas à terminer dans le corps de Dahlia Margaret, un personnage de roman qu'elle connaît bien. Un destin plutôt agréable et qui rattrape celui de sa vie passée, dans laquelle elle subissait solitude et harcèlement. Ou du moins c'est ce qu'elle pensait, jusqu'à ce que Flore, sa sœur fictive fasse son apparition et que Minjoo se rende compte qu'elle ressemble très étrangement à la camarade de classe qui la persécutait. Afin de garder une vie agréable, mais également de se venger, elle a donc besoin d'un allié puissant, et quoi de mieux que le séduisant Grand duc, Johan, pour remplir ce rôle? Seulement, il se pourrait bien que cette alliance avec ce mystérieux jeune homme lui réserve bien des surprises...
description.id:
Aku bereinkarnasi ke dalam sebuah novel yang kubaca bersama si penganiaya yang telah menjerumuskanku ke neraka. Si penganiaya itu menjadi 'Florre' yang merupakan tokoh utama dalam novel, sedangkan aku menjadi antagonis yang akan mati secara mengenaskan bernama 'Dahlia'.

Aku, Dahlia yang merupakan antagonis berencana untuk membalaskan dendamku pada Florre sang tokoh utama yang telah dimasuki oleh si penganiaya diriku di dunia sebelumnya, yaitu Lee Suyeon. Aku menyiapkan rencana dan menjalankan semuanya demi itu.

"Yang Mulia Grand Duke, maukah anda menikah dengan saya?"
"Apa... yang baru saja anda katakan?"
"Lalu, mari kita balaskan dendam kita bersama."

Yohan Descartes Servien, kakak tiri dari tokoh pria utama, Noel yang ditakdirkan untuk dihukum setelah melakukan pengkhianatan.
Aku tidak boleh melewatkan pria yang akan menjadi sekutu terbaikku ini.

Karena aku sudah bereinkarnasi ke dalam tubuh ini, aku akan memanfaatkannya dengan baik.
Lee Suyeon, rasakanlah juga rasanya terjerumus ke dalam neraka.
description.ko: 내게 지옥을 선사한 가해자와 함께 읽었던 소설에 빙의해버렸다. 가해자는 여주인공인 '플로레'로, 나는 끔찍하게 죽게 될 악녀 '달리아'로. "대공 전하, 저와 결혼하시지 않으시겠어요?" "지금… 뭐라고 하셨습니까?" "그리고 함께 복수해요." 남주인공인 노엘의 이복 형이자 이후 반역을 일으켜 처단될, 운명인 요한 데카르트 세르비엔. 내 복수의 최고의 아군이 될 남자를 놓쳐서는 안 된다. 악녀의 몸에 빙의한 이상, 이 몸을 철저하게 사용해주겠어. 이수연, 너도 지옥 속으로 빠져봐.
description.ru: Я не смогла терпеть издевательств и поэтому покончила с собой, но перевоплотилась вместе с виновницей издевательств? Она стала героиней - Флёрр, а я - злодейкой - Далией, которая умрёт ужасной смертью.Все говорят, вы злодейка, что любит проливать кровь, но в отличие от слухов вы чаще льёте слёзы."— Ваше Высочество должно быть верит в глупости, о которых любят идиоты говорить, я права?Великий Герцог Сервиан, сводный брат Главного Героя, который вскоре после этого будет казнён за измену. Неожиданно появился передо мной и я не могу потерять такого человека, который станет для меня величайшим союзником.— Ваше Высочество, прошу женитесь на мне!— Что ты сейчас сказал?— И тогда мы сможем отомстить вместе.Скучный сюжет, понятный финал. Ведь Героиня не единственная, кто знает концовку новеллы. Я выбираю путь долгой, но сладкой мести.
description.th: หลังจากฆ่าตัวตาย ฉันก็หลุดเข้าไปในนิยายที่อ่าน มิหนำซ้ำยังมาอยู่ในร่างของตัวร้ายที่ต้องตายอย่างทรมานอีกต่างหาก! แต่ลีซูยอนที่คอยแกล้งฉันกลับหลุดเข้ามาในฐานะนางเอกของเรื่องซะงั้น… เอาล่ะ แบบนี้ก็เข้าท่าสิ คราวนี้ฉันนี่แหละที่จะทำให้เธอเหมือนตกนรกทั้งเป็น!
description.zh: 达莉亚穿成小说里的恶女角色还是个秒死的反派，而曾经霸凌过自己的女同学居然也穿进了小说里？还是女主？等着吧！这一世我要把你捧上天堂，再狠狠摔下来。
description.pt-br: Renascida em um romance de fantasia como uma personagem perversa fadada a encontrar uma morte precoce, Minjoo - agora Dahlia Margaret - tem muito o que fazer desde o início. Mas pelo menos ela agora está livre de sua cruel valentona do ensino médio, Sooyeon. Ou não? Quando Dahlia conhece Flore, sua irmã afastada e protagonista do romance, ela fica chocada ao descobrir que a garota tem uma semelhança suspeita com a colega de classe que a atormentou. Agora, movida pelo desejo de salvar sua própria vida e também se vingar, Dahlia precisa fazer um aliado poderoso, e ela está de olho em um belo membro da realeza que pode ser perfeito para o trabalho. No entanto, um acordo com esse homem misterioso pode significar mais do que ela esperava.
description.zh-hk: 因無法忍受霸凌而自殺後，竟然和加害者一起進入了小說！加害者變成女主角佩洛蕾，而我變成最後會悲慘死去的惡女妲莉雅。我拉攏了男主角同父異母的哥哥，也就是將在日後發起叛變的約翰·塞爾維安大公，他會是我最可靠的援軍。相似的處境、既定的結局，知道小說結局的人可不只有女主角，我選擇了漫長又辛苦的復仇之路。

description.en:
"Alex, vengeful Elf is on a vendetta against the so-called "Chosen ones" who keep the peace of the land ever since their ancestors vanquished the Dark Lord Gob-Khan a millennia ago.
Seeking to destroy the world that has betrayed her, Alex awakens the Dark Lord from his thousand-year-old slumber only to find that he's... a goblin.
Will this pathetic little green creature manage to live up to his seemingly unjustified reputation and help Alex bring apocalypse upon the world?"

Afin de détruire le monde, Alex l'elfe ressuscite l'ancien roi démon mais il finit par être un gobelin! Avec un roi démon gobelin, un elfe et un orc pacifiste peuvent-ils vraiment détruire le monde et vaincre les puissants guerriers?

世界を火に包んだ混沌の魔王がいた。勇者との戦いの末に封印された魔王。しかし再び目を覚ますときが来た・・・が、なんと魔王はゴブリンだった！？
打倒勇者を目指して、封印を解いたエルフとゴブリンだった魔王の不思議な冒険がはじまる！

[천 년만에 부활한 전설의 마왕이 고블린?] 엘프 알렉스는 세계멸망을 위해 고대의 마왕을 부활시키지만, 부활한 마왕 고브칸은 고블린이었다. 세계멸망을 위해 파티원을 모으지만, 모인 건 고블린 마왕에 엘프 무투가, 평화주의자 오크. 이 파티로 과연 세계멸망 가능한가? 예측 불허의 전개와 짜릿한 액션이 작렬하는 구감각 로우 판타지

Эльф Алекс пытается возродить древнего Короля Демонов, чтобы разрушить этот мир. Однако этот Король оказался гоблином Гобканом.
Ради своей цели он создает команду, однако ее членами являются Король Демонов-гоблин, эльф Мутуга, Орк – пацифист. Сможет ли такая команда разрушить мир?
Старый добрый жанр фэнтези с непредсказуемым развитием событий и захватывающим экшеном.

description.en:
When the war between the Justice Alliance and the Heavenly Demon Coalition, known as The Great Demon War, was at its peak, Sim Ho lived in the peaceful village of Baekriju.
At the age of twelve, he becomes caught up in Jegal Hwi’s plot to take over Baekriju and is dragged to The Cheonil Plain, the war’s frontline. In the midst of a desperate battle, he encounters The Black Ox fighters, who save his life. He is then assigned to their group and thus begins the arduous journey to learn martial arts so that he can grow into a powerful warrior and return home to Baekriju…!
description.pt-br:
Durante a época em que as duas facções, Jeonggeomryeon e Jibmacheon, confrontavam-se na Guerra da Justiça e dos Demônios, que se espalhou por todo o pais.

Shimho, um garoto de Baekriju, um vilarejo pacífico, caiu na conspiração de Je Galhwi para roubar Baekriju.

Aos doze anos, ele foi arrastado para cheonilpyeong, onde fica a vanguarda da Guerra da Justiça e dos Demônios.

No meio da batalha feroz, conheceu os Touros Negros.

Ele se tornou aliado deles, aprendeu artes marciais e ficou mais forte.

Assim, começa sua jornada difícil para retornar ao seu lar, Baekriju...

32 years ago—judgement day. Humans were driven to the brink of extinction by the sudden appearance of monsters. However, with the appearance of supernatural powers and the awakening of abilities, the battle went into its next phase. After a fierce battle, the lost lands were reclaimed. The surviving monsters formed dungeons all over the world and threatened humanity. In order to prevent a tragedy like this from happening again, Cannes Inc. developed a virtual reality game called Lost City and began nurturing hunters. Ranker Jinsoo Kwon has never been defeated in Lost City. He became a hunter for his sister Kwon Soo-ah, and he conquers the dungeons with Apple, who appeared with his unique ability. Then, finally, he meets Kenneth, who he has been looking for for a long time, and hears about the secrets hidden in this world... There is no defeat for me! I will not forgive anyone who harms my family!

32년 전 심판의 날.
갑작스럽게 나타난 몬스터들에 의해 인류는 멸종 직전까지 몰리게 된다. 
하지만 독특한 능력을 사용하는 이능력자들이 각성하며 싸움은 새로운 국면을 맞이하고 치열한 전투 끝에 잃어버린 땅을 되찾는다.

살아남은 몬스터들은 전세계 곳곳에 던전을 형성하며 인간을 위협하고,
인류는 제2의 참극을 막기 위해 주식회사 ‘칸’에선 로스트 시티라는 가상현실 게임을 개발해 헌터들을 육성하기 시작한다.

로스트시티에서 무패의 기록을 가진 랭커 권진수.
여동생 권수아를 위해 헌터가 된 그는 고유능력으로 나타난 애플과 함께 던전을 정복해 나간다.

32 года назад, судный день.
Из-за внезапного нападения монстров человечество оказалось на грани вымирания. Однако в людях стали пробуждаться уникальные способности, битва приняла новый оборот. После затяжного кровавого противостояния человечеству наконец удалось вернуть отобранные земли. Выжившие монстры разбрелись по всей планете, формируя подземелья и запугивая людей.
Чтобы предотвратить вторую трагедию, акционерная компания Кан разработала игру виртуальной реальности под названием "Потерянный город" и занялась активными тренировками охотников.
Квон Чжинсу - ранкер "Потерянного города" без единого проигрыша на счету. Ради сестры он становится охотником и штурмует подземелья на пару с устройством, появившимся благодаря суперспособностям.
Пока он наконец не узнаёт секреты этого мира и не встречает Кенета, которого так долго искал...

description.en:
Once a rising martial arts master, Jagak Yang is known as the Ten Strike Finisher due to his ability to defeat any opponent within ten moves. Jagak is also the son of the leader of the Great Martial Alliance, an organization of virtuous martial arts sects. His future leadership over the martial arts world seems all but assured -- that is, until he is assassinated by jealous rivals! Jagak is reincarnated into the body of Cheonso Ma, the playboy second-in-command of the evil Shining Light Cult. Can Jagak remain true to his principles despite his new life on the dark side?

description.fr: Yang Ja-Gak fut empoisonné pendant la guerre politique des sectes. Alors qu’il pensait être mort, il réalisa alors qu’il était maintenant dans le corps d’une autre personne. Il se rendit compte qu’il faisait partie du Culte Démoniaque et que l’art martial qu’il maîtrisais maintenant était celui du Dieu Céleste Démoniaque et que le propriétaire du corps dans lequel il est est l’héritier fou qui ne faisait que convoiter les femmes. Pourquoi fallait-il que ça tombe sur lui ?! Et pourquoi est-ce qu’il a atterrit dans son corps à lui ?!
description.ja: 武林の政争に巻き込まれ毒殺された古今随一の奇才、楊子閣。 死んだに違いないと思ったが、目が覚めると自分の魂が違う者の体に宿っていることに気がつく。自分がいるのは魔教、体得した武功は天魔神功であり、この体の持ち主は女性を弄び悪霊よりもひどい行いをする不成者の小教主。 よりによってなぜ魔教なのか？
description.ko:
무림의 정쟁에 휘말려 독살당한 고금 제일의 기재, 양자각.
분명 죽은 줄로 알았으나 정신을 차리게 되고, 자신이 다른 사람의 몸에 들어와 있다는 것을 알게 된다.
알고 보니 자신이 있는 곳은 마교, 익힌 무공은 천마신공,
이 몸의 주인은 여색을 탐하고 악귀보다 더한 짓을 하는 망나니 소교주?
왜 하필이면 마교에다 이 사람인가!?
description.ru: Ян Чагак, убитый ядом во время политических войн в Муриме, после смерти очнулся в неизвестном месте и вскоре выяснил, что находится в демоническом культе, а изучаемые им техники - высшее искусство владыки демонов, к тому же тело принадлежит безумному наследнику, жаждущему женщин.
description.zh:
武林盟主之子成魔教教主！
是正义致远还是步入邪途？
扬子阁，被称为旷世奇才的他意外在武林夺位战中被毒杀身亡。没想到一睁眼，自己的魂魄竟进入了他人的身躯。不仅如此，发誓一生要行侠仗义的他居然入住了魔教之地，学的武功也是魔教神功，而且他自己变成了一个贪图女色，无恶不作的魔教少教主?!为什么偏偏要重生为魔教之人?!
description.pt-br: Yang Jagak, que foi assassinado com veneno durante as guerra políticas do Murim. Enquanto ele pensou que estava morto, ele percebeu que estava no outro corpo de outra pessoa. Ele descobriu que estava no Culto Demoníaco, a arte que ele conhece eram as Artes Divinas do Demônio Celestial e o proprietário do corpo era o incontrolável herdeiro que cobiçava as mulheres. Por que tinha que ter sido o Culto Demoníaco e por que tinha que ser essa pessoa?
description.zh-hk: 被捲入武林政治鬥爭的古今第一奇才，梁自覺，明明以為死了，醒來卻發現自己在別人身體裡。了解後才知道，自己所在的地方是魔教，練成的武功則是天魔神功。這身體的主人還是個愛好女色，比惡鬼還可惡的不良小教主？為什麼偏偏是在魔教的這個人啊？

description.en:
On her way back home late one night, office worker Sophie stumbles into another world where she's a princess?! Well that's what Alan, prince of the Lapis Kingdom, says. To return to her world she must fulfill the prophecy and help Alan become king. Sophie agrees but...amidst a war for the crown, can she survive?

(Source: Tapas)
description.ko:
하윤은 대기업 비서로서 여러 군데에서 입사제의를 받을 정도로 유능한 인재이다.    
퇴근길에 하윤은 이세계 ‘라피스 제국’으로 떨어지게 되고, 그곳에서 제국의 황자인 앨런을 만나게 된다.
앨런은 하윤을 예언의 그녀라 칭하며 자신이 황태자가 되는 것을 도우라하고, 
하윤은 자신이 살던 곳으로 돌아가기 위해 앨런의 제안에 동의한다.
앨런의 약혼녀 행세로 민심과 황제의 마음을 사로잡고 앨런과도 점점 가까워지며 사랑의 감정을 느끼는데...
description.ru: Ся Юнь работает секретарем крупной компании. Многие фирмы-конкуренты хотят её заполучить. По пути с работы она попадает в иной мир - Империю Ляпис, где встречает кронпринца Аллана. Аллан называет Ся Фунь "пророчеством", и просит помощи в своем восхождении на трон. Героиня согласна, но в обмен на возвращение в свой мир. Так она становится невестой Аллана, очаровывая простых людей и самого Императора, при этом теряя голову от любви к Аллану.
description.pt-br: Em seu caminho de volta para casa tarde da noite, a funcionária de escritório Sophie tropeça em outro mundo onde ela é uma princesa?! Bem, isso é o que Alan, príncipe do Reino Lapis, diz. Para retornar ao seu mundo, ela deve cumprir a profecia e ajudar Alan a se tornar rei. Sophie concorda, mas... em meio a uma guerra pela coroa, ela pode sobreviver?

description.en:
Jinho Lee has just completed the ultimate challenge in the game Reset Life, where he had to experience all 99 possible endings to reach the final victory. After six years of intense gameplay, he feels a sense of achievement—but also an overwhelming emptiness. With nothing left to conquer in the game, Jinho finds himself at a loss, unsure of what to do next.

However, this feeling of burnout becomes the catalyst for an even greater transformation. Suddenly, Jinho’s life is reset in ways he never imagined—he becomes the top scorer in the nation, a model, a chef, and even a celebrity. What once seemed like distant dreams are now his new reality. But with this newfound success comes the question: is this truly the life he wanted?

Due to his unique ability of seeing guardian fairies, Eun-Oh is deemed to be a loner. One day, the new transfer student Jae Hwi approached him without hesitation! "I feel good whenever I'm with you." After being told such words, Eun-Oh started to have a change of heart…
description.es: Debido a su habilidad única de ver hadas guardianas, Eun-Oh es considerado un solitario. ¡Un día, el nuevo estudiante transferido Jae Hwi se le acercó sin dudarlo! "Me siento bien cuando estoy contigo". Después de que le dijeran esas palabras, Eun-Oh comenzó a tener un cambio en su corazón…

description.en: "Giju is usually the most rational person around, but when it comes to love, she becomes completely foolish. During an argument with her boyfriend, the one she thought would be different this time, she accidentally falls down the stairs. When she regains her consciousness in the hospital, some strange review windows appears before her eyes. “What is this? Reviews written by his ex-girlfriends… rating my boyfriend?” Could these review windows be the salvation Giju needs for her love life?
description.ko:
평소엔 누구보다 이성적!

“You’re mine.”

When Raphia met her demise after having been used and thrown away by her benefactor, Yuri, she went back nine years in the past.

‘I’m not going to relive that hell!’

Running away from her benefactor, she went to Kasein Soleia, Yuri’s archnemesis, and signed a new sponsorship contract with him.

“I shall kill every single person you despise, Milord.”

“The necessary role happens to be open, and you might just be the right person for it.”

Young Duke. This is a sponsorship contract, right? But why . . . why are we getting married?

===

“Throughout the time I won’t be by your side . . . I will think of nothing but your small, cute head.”

That low voice sent shivers down her spine.

“I can’t believe you’re leaving. I’ll just . . .”

Kasein looked at her sharply as if he was daring her to continue making up excuses.

“You have to answer well, brat. Depending on what you say, all the wagon and shoe craftsmen of the Empire might lose their livelihood.”

Despite his harsh words, Kasein’s touch was gentle. He couldn’t take his eyes off of Raphia, who strangely grew more beautiful by the day.

description.en:
An outcast from the imperial family due to her freewheeling attitude and refusal to get married, Princess Melody Corbella wants nothing more than to live life on her own terms and protect the people of the empire. Using her secret powers to sneak out of the palace to influence affairs from behind the scenes, she ends up drawing the attention of the handsome imperial guard, Caisar Bethel. Though she avoided romance until now, could love finally bloom for this crazy flower?
___
“I, Melody Corbella, wish to marry him!” The rest of the table reacted in a cold enough manner for the Princess to feel ashamed, having raised her right arm vigorously with sparkles in her eyes.

And then, Prince Deimos broke the silence to open his mouth, “We must not send a nutcase like her, Your Majesty!!”

It was finally the moment where all of her crazy deeds in the past came to fruition; because the only way she could escape being sent off for Royal Marriage was to throw away the image of a Princess that everyone expected.

She chose to cut her hair short and be reborn as the Crazy Flower in the Royal Palace.
description.fr: Quand la princesse Mélodie Corbella déclare avec enthousiasme au cours d’une réunion d’état qu’elle souhaite faire un mariage princier, un vent glacial souffle sur l’assemblée. Seul le prince Deïmos réagit avec virulence et implore l’Empereur de ne surtout pas marier cette folle à qui que ce soit. Mélodie attendait cet instant depuis un an, un an à faire tout son possible pour quitter son image de princesse et à se faire passer pour une folle afin d’échapper à un mariage princier qu’elle refuse catégoriquement. Après s’être coupé les cheveux et avoir abandonné les robes pour des pantalons bien plus confortables, la princesse renaît en fleur sauvage.

“Majesteleri! Ulusun temsilcisi olarak gerçekten evlenmek istiyorum!!! Majesteleri! Gerçekten evlenmek istiyorum. Aizen İmparatorluğu olmasa bile Vladimir Krallığı’na gelin gidebilirim! Kralın yakında evleneceğini duydum! Lüks ve refah içinde yaşamak istiyorum!!”
“Majesteleri, bu deli prensesin söylediklerini duyuyor musunuz?!
“Majesteleri, bu deli prensesi oraya gönderirseniz bizi alay konusu yaparsınız!”
Huzur ve rahatlık içinde yaşamanın en iyi yolu buydu! Hatta imparatorluktaki en yakışıklı adam olduğu söylenen Cesar Bethel ile evlenmeyi bile planlıyordum. Ama… Garip bir şeyler var.
“Dövüş benimle”.
Hayır, böyle olmamalıydı.
Ek olarak, hiç vicdanı olmayan prens bile,
“Benimle gel, Melody”.

Huzurlu ve rahat bir hayat yaşamak istiyordum… bunu nasıl başaracağım?!

description.en:
I was reborn as Ashley Rosé, the daughter of the 8th wife of the Emperor of Estria. I thought I was going to live a long and happy life in luxury, but soon I realized that I was an extra in the book 'Light of Rusbella' I had once read. While cleaning, I discovered a magic diary that seemed to fortell the future, and learned that nothing but ruin awaited me because Ashley Rosé was destined to die by the hands of the Crown Prince, Castor the Tyrant!

“What does the empire mean to you?” the Crown Prince asked, smiling oh so very beautifully. And then he killed me.

But after my death, I woke up once again in the past, only to be killed over and over again. As I continued to relive my deaths, I slowly lost my smile and changed. Let’s just try to survive first.

“What can I do for my elder brother?”
“Well,” Pale sky-blue hair fluttered softly in the wind. He smiled weakly, before parting his dry lips, “Call my name.”
“…” My head quickly snapped up.
“Call me… Amoru.”
His fingertips skimmed along the inside of my wrist.

“Death is only the beginning.” 

Truer words were never spoken for young Leon von Marbas, the heir to a once-great house of necromancers. Forced to execute his own father by the lord of a rival house, Leon suddenly finds himself the leader of a declining clan under threat from enemies within and without. 

The only way to restore the glory of his house? Leon must strike a pact with the demon Marbas, the original source of the powerful necromancy that House Marbas was once known for…

description.en:
After a life of hardship as an orphan, Jia Han finally achieves the dream of homeownership... only to have her moment of jubilation cruelly cut short. While indulging in her guilty pleasure--a riveting soap opera--she experiences a sudden, piercing chest pain and meets an untimely demise. But when she wakes up, she finds herself not in the afterlife, but within the very drama she was watching and as none other than its villainess! In a realm where a glance sparks a scandal and a step triggers a landmine of emotions, what fate lies ahead for Jia?

---
The main character, who grew up as an orphan, finally achieves her dream of owning her own home after suffering.
Her joy was short-lived and she suddenly died while watching a drama she enjoyed, feeling pain in her chest. However, when she opened her eyes again, she was in a drama she had watched before she died! And that too, while possessing Shin Sera, a villain who tries to kill the female protagonist, but is destroyed by the male protagonists!

Shin Sera Loving's main character tries to escape from the drama to prevent her destruction, but there is a succession rival who hates her, a fiancé who doesn't even treat her as a human being, and a pervert with a blank face.... With a variety of male protagonists with outbursts of personality, are you getting more and more entangled?

Lorsqu'elle rouvre les yeux, elle découvre qu'elle se trouve à l'intérieur du feuilleton qu'elle regardait avant de mourir ! Pire encore, elle s'est réincarnée en Shin Sera, une méchante qui tente de tuer le personnage principal féminin et qui est finalement tuée par le personnage principal masculin !

description.en:
I got reincarnated in a tragedy novel. Just before my favourite character turns into the villain! If this goes on like this, my favourite character will turn into the villain and die. I can’t just let my favourite character die like that, I’ll try my best to save him. But how? By getting married!

---
Countless marriage proposal rejections are nothing for Lamille Claude, a newly reincarnated character in the dark fantasy novel *The Broken Sword*. Her mission is to prevent the male lead, Roel Arnen, from succumbing to all his misery and becoming the story’s villain. To do so, she’ll need to bring him under her protection as her husband until he regains the ability to use his legs and reclaims his former glory. But it isn’t easy considering Roel’s reluctance to accept Lamille’s confessions of love. Will Lamille be able to win Roel’s heart in time to save him from his tragic fate?
description.fr: Quoi de mieux que de se réincarner dans son roman favori et d’avoir l’opportunité de rencontrer son personnage préféré? Lamille, une chevaleresse talentueuse au fort caractère, est bien décidée à sauver Roel Arnen, le héros du roman tragique qu’elle aimait tant. Mais cette fois-ci, pas question de laisser l’histoire devenir une tragédie! L’objectif de Lamille: se rapprocher de Roel pour lui apporter son soutien. En effet, le jeune homme était un chevalier renommé et talentueux, mais un terrible accident l’a privé de l’usage de ses jambes. Dans le roman, Roel devint un méchant suite à cet évènement et fit face à de nombreuses épreuves avant de mourir tragiquement… alors pour Lamille, hors de question de laisser ça se produire sans rien faire! Elle compte bien devenir son alliée fidèle et l’aider à être heureux… même si pour ça elle doit aller jusqu'à une demande en mariage!
